$comment: Exceptions to @effect/language-service error/warning diagnostics (WS-0026). Checked by scripts/ts/effect-diagnostics.ts: every finding must match an entry by file + rule, and every entry must still match exactly `count` findings (a stale or wrong-count entry fails the check). Suggestion-severity diagnostics are not gated.

exceptions.reason: Two chained Effect.provide calls (services(env), then platform): one in runLazyIngestion (index.ts ~172, where catchDefect wraps the provided effect as the documented recovery boundary) and one in the scheduled handler (index.ts ~225, local-preview-only, no catchDefect). The fix is a dependency-chain rewrite (Layer.provide), not a flat merge, and the first site's recovery boundary needs a decision, so it is deferred rather than changed under R1 (WS-0026 review N3).
exceptions.retirement: Retire in TB-05: the event-driven ingestion loop replaces runLazyIngestion and the scheduled handler at the composition root.
